applicationContract: The pinned did-enter-background and will-enter-foreground pages explicitly name UIApplication as notification object. Active/inactive pages describe transition but omit object wording. This observer conservatively accepts only object === supplied current UIApplication for every app kind, and refuses nil/other objects; it does not infer complete coverage from registration.
sceneContract: Connect/disconnect/activate/deactivate/foreground pages explicitly name the affected scene as object. Background page omits object wording. All scene events require object === current weak-owned-window.windowScene and otherwise are filtered.
source: Pinned Apple developer Markdown documents; data only, no implementation import.
uncertainty: No runtime execution validates actual UIKit delivery, ordering, object conventions or scope through association changes. Conservative filtering can miss events rather than admitting unowned objects. No cause/success inference follows.
windowContract: All four pinned UIWindow pages name the affected window as object; each documents main actor posting.
